versions.title: First complete daily video diary workflow
versions.summary: Established the path from raw thought to teleprompter script, phone recording, subtitle MP4, cover, export pack, and log.
changes: Used scripted subtitles estimated from the teleprompter text.
knownLimits: Subtitle timing was estimated instead of transcribed from real speech.
Cover style was basic and not versioned.

versions.title: Visual style and cover-first workflow
versions.summary: Moved cover confirmation before full editing and tightened subtitle, typography, and safe-area rules.
changes: Added cover-first production order after video upload.
Moved subtitles from scripted estimates to real recording transcription by default.
Added 20 percent horizontal subtitle safe area.
knownLimits: Visual rules existed, but production statistics were still partly scattered in logs.
Support for non-diary columns was still emerging.

versions.title: Two-agent workflow and structured state layer
versions.summary: Reduced the production model to Text Agent and Video Agent, with 00_state as the source of truth for long-term statistics.
changes: Split execution into Text Agent for raw ideas/scripts and Video Agent for cover/edit/export/log.
Added 00_state/day-counter.json, content-ledger.csv, production-stats.csv, and publish-ledger.csv as structured state.
Separated content date from actual production timestamp.
Made production-stats.csv the monthly review source of truth instead of scanning remaining media files.
knownLimits: History could be read from docs and logs, but was not yet queryable as product data.
Compliance edits were visible in filenames/logs, not yet first-class dashboard events.

versions.title: Compliance Agent and platform review gates
versions.summary: Adds a Compliance Agent for input and output review before script generation and before publishing.
changes: Added Compliance Agent as a third Sub Agent beside Text Agent and Video Agent.
Added input compliance review before Text Agent generates a publish script.
Added output compliance review before the user publishes.
Kept Compliance Agent out of script generation and video production.
knownLimits: Platform rules are still manually maintained Markdown references.
Compliance decisions still need human confirmation when platform feedback is ambiguous.

complianceAgent.name: Compliance Agent
complianceAgent.scope: input and output platform compliance review

historyQueryCapability.name: Workflow History Query
historyQueryCapability.scope: answer version evolution and run-history questions from structured workflow data
historyQueryCapability.agent: product capability, not a source Sub Agent
